meta.name: WealthSmith Semantic Breakpoint Tokens
meta.description: Semantic responsive behavior tokens for the WealthSmith design system. These tokens explain how product layouts should behave at each viewport range.

mobile.description: Small-screen mobile layout range. Use single-column layouts, compact spacing, and overlay navigation or AI panels.

tablet.description: Medium-screen tablet layout range. Use expanded card layouts, 8-column grid behavior, and overlay AI panels.

desktop.description: Desktop layout range. Use 12-column grid behavior, wider dashboard layouts, and allow persistent side panels.

wide.description: Widescreen layout range. Use maximum content width, spacious layout rhythm, and persistent side panels where useful.

mobile.description: Use 4-column grid behavior for mobile layouts

tablet.description: Use 8-column grid behavior for tablet layouts

desktop.description: Use 12-column grid behavior for desktop layouts

wide.description: Use 12-column grid behavior for widescreen layouts

desktop.description: Default maximum content width for desktop product screens

wide.description: Maximum content width for widescreen product layouts

mobile.description: Use compact navigation, drawer navigation, or bottom navigation depending on product context

tablet.description: Use adaptive navigation that can collapse or expand depending on available horizontal space

desktop.description: Use expanded sidebar or top-level navigation where appropriate

wide.description: Use expanded navigation with stable desktop layout behavior

mobile.description: Smith AI should open as an overlay or full-screen panel on mobile

tablet.description: Smith AI should open as an overlay panel on tablet

desktop.description: Smith AI may appear as a persistent or toggleable side panel on desktop

wide.description: Smith AI may appear as a persistent or toggleable side panel on widescreen layouts

mobile.description: Use compact density with clear vertical stacking and minimal side-by-side content

tablet.description: Use balanced density with limited side-by-side content

desktop.description: Use comfortable density with multi-column layouts where helpful

wide.description: Use spacious density while keeping content constrained to readable max widths

mobile.description: Cards should stack vertically on mobile

tablet.description: Cards may use one or two columns depending on content priority

desktop.description: Cards may use multi-column dashboard layouts

wide.description: Cards may use multi-column layouts but should stay within max content width

mobile.description: Tables should stack into cards or allow controlled horizontal scrolling on mobile

tablet.description: Tables may hide lower-priority columns or use adaptive layouts

desktop.description: Tables may show full column sets on desktop

wide.description: Tables may show full column sets while respecting max content width
